title: The Lord of the Rings
synopsis: A humble hobbit inherits a powerful ring and joins a fellowship on a perilous journey across Middle-earth to destroy it before the Dark Lord Sauron can conquer the world.

direction.subject: A determined hobbit protagonist clutching a glowing golden ring, wearing a weathered grey traveling cloak with a leaf-shaped brooch.
direction.setting: The rugged, volcanic landscape of Middle-earth, featuring jagged obsidian peaks and a distant mountain erupting with amber light.
direction.palette: High-contrast palette of charcoal black, fiery ember orange, and cold slate blue.
direction.composition: Cinematic wide-angle view with the subject on the lower-left third, looking toward a massive focal point in the distance.
continuity_rules: The Ring must have faint, glowing orange inscriptions
The protagonist's cloak must be charcoal grey with a silver leaf clasp
The sky must be filled with turbulent, dark storm clouds and volcanic ash
direction.cover_prompt: Cinematic 16:9 wide shot of a small hobbit in a tattered grey cloak standing on a dark, jagged cliffside. He looks toward a distant, massive volcano erupting with fiery light. The atmosphere is thick with smoke and volumetric lighting. Photorealistic high-fantasy, intricate textures, epic scale, 8k resolution.
direction.thumbnail_prompt: 16:9 YouTube thumbnail with high saturation and extreme contrast. A close-up of a hand holding the glowing One Ring with visible fire-runes. In the background, a massive flaming eye looms over a dark mountain range. Large, bold centered text reads 'The Lord of the Rings'. Vibrant orange and deep black color grade, sharp focus, hyper-detailed.
